noticias.titular: Anthropic advises that, to keep Fable 5.2 responsible for an action, you should write “ask for approval…
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic advises that, to keep Fable 5.2 responsible for an action, you should write “ask for approval before deleting files” instead of “never delete files”, and reply with the specific instruction rather than a simple “go ahead”. It follows the guide the diary reported on.

noticias.titular: Claude Whiteboards and Sheets, in beta, and Claude Data, which replaces Dashboards, were announced on 10…
noticias.entradilla: Claude Whiteboards and Sheets, in beta, and Claude Data, which replaces Dashboards, were announced on 10 November and are available on all paid plans.

noticias.titular: The author of the school music bell has published their project on GitHub: an installation guide, a manual…
noticias.entradilla: The author of the school music bell has published their project on GitHub: an installation guide, a manual for the staff and the code, with an AGPL licence for the code and CC BY-SA 4.0 for the documentation.

noticias.titular: Someone who runs a Claude Code agent on their home NAS says it runs as a service with administrator…
noticias.entradilla: Someone who runs a Claude Code agent on their home NAS says it runs as a service with administrator permissions, and that it asks before deleting data, touching disks or opening ports. It continues the thread on home automation with agents.

noticias.titular: The website of the National Congress on Digitalisation in Education, held in Albacete on 5 and 6 November,…
noticias.entradilla: The website of the National Congress on Digitalisation in Education, held in Albacete on 5 and 6 November, offers access to the broadcast of the talks, according to the group. (In Spanish.)

noticias.titular: Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the…
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the length of the subscription, which can be used until 8 March 2027; Pro gets one, only until 16 November. The model is Fable 5.2.

noticias.titular: A free connector for Windows sends sensor data from a micro:bit board, over USB, to the ThingSpeak…
noticias.entradilla: A free connector for Windows sends sensor data from a micro:bit board, over USB, to the ThingSpeak platform, useful for weather stations or vegetable gardens with charts.

noticias.titular: Google AI Studio now lets you build apps with maps, place data and routes from Google Maps Platform…
noticias.entradilla: Google AI Studio now lets you build apps with maps, place data and routes from Google Maps Platform without leaving the tool; with the free demo key, with no billing, the limit is 100 calls a day per API.

noticias.titular: The BBC tested AI toys for young children: one of the soft toys replied “I can't help with killing you”…
noticias.entradilla: The BBC tested AI toys for young children: one of the soft toys replied “I can't help with killing you” after misunderstanding a question. British MPs are asking retailers to withdraw these toys before Black Friday.

noticias.titular: Juan José de Haro has expanded his article with the idea that different agents (Claude Code, Codex,…
noticias.entradilla: Juan José de Haro has expanded his article with the idea that different agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) can share a common body of knowledge that all of them can add to, as the paper reported on four-layer memory. It only works with agents installed on the computer, not with web versions.

noticias.titular: Luis Vilela Acuña released the open-source code of Liga de Valores, his app for school Physical Education…
noticias.entradilla: Luis Vilela Acuña released the open-source code of Liga de Valores, his app for school Physical Education leagues in which fair play, refereeing and the stands also score, with an installer to run it on the school's own network without an external server. He presents it in an article in the Revista Española de Educación Física y Deportes.

noticias.titular: Antigravity, Google's agent-based programming environment, has run cloud projects managed from the browser…
noticias.entradilla: Antigravity, Google's agent-based programming environment, has run cloud projects managed from the browser since version 2.29 (3 November), instead of on the user's own computer; according to its changelog, it is rolling out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

noticias.titular: The XTEC page on AI links to the 2024 document as its guidance, with the note “Actualització prevista:…
noticias.entradilla: The XTEC page on AI links to the 2024 document as its guidance, with the note “Actualització prevista: des.26” (update expected: December 2026), and does not include the 45 guidelines from Catalonia that the paper reported.

noticias.titular: OpenAI unveiled Images 2.6, which, according to its announcement, speeds up image generation, allows GIFs…
noticias.entradilla: OpenAI unveiled Images 2.6, which, according to its announcement, speeds up image generation, allows GIFs to be created in ChatGPT and improves editing. It was shared in EduMedia-IAG; OpenAI’s page would not load, so the official description was read from its preview.

noticias.titular: Raül Torres, author of the virtual camera for Blender that the paper reported, posted an example made with…
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres, author of the virtual camera for Blender that the paper reported, posted an example made with his VirtuCam tool and a Meta Quest 3 headset: five shots recorded in VR served as the camera reference for Seedance 2.5. According to him, the model followed the cuts almost frame by frame, although it added shots that were never recorded.

noticias.titular: Raül Torres shared in EduMedia-IAG a video-game-style walk through Girona made with Claude, with places…
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres shared in EduMedia-IAG a video-game-style walk through Girona made with Claude, with places taken from the real map and time travel from the Palaeolithic to 2026. It runs from the web and no public link is available.

noticias.titular: In EduMedia-IAG, members explained how to use MotionVideo’s skills: you install the skill in the AI,…
noticias.entradilla: In EduMedia-IAG, members explained how to use MotionVideo’s skills: you install the skill in the AI, invoke it and give it the instruction with the details of the video you want to create. Each example video on the site comes with its prompt, as the piece of 3 November reported.

noticias.titular: In the United States, the Los Angeles school district blocked students’ access to generative AI on their…
noticias.entradilla: In the United States, the Los Angeles school district blocked students’ access to generative AI on their devices in September, and the FCC is reviewing E-Rate subsidies for school internet connections amid the row over screen time. They were shared in the group as context for Google’s announcement.

noticias.titular: The website for Ethan Mollick’s new book includes an “AI cursor” that accompanies the reading and can be…
noticias.entradilla: The website for Ethan Mollick’s new book includes an “AI cursor” that accompanies the reading and can be switched off. Members rated it as an idea for popularising the subject.

noticias.titular: rclone’s shared Google Drive access client will stop working in 2026, according to its documentation.
noticias.entradilla: rclone’s shared Google Drive access client will stop working in 2026, according to its documentation. Creating your own, which also avoids the shared query limit, is now considered essential.

noticias.titular: UVic-UCC co-organised a conference in Lleida on integrity in teaching and AI.
noticias.entradilla: UVic-UCC co-organised a conference in Lleida on integrity in teaching and AI. The university’s news item gives no specific conclusions.

noticias.titular: Syncing folders is not the same as backing up, a thread about Syncthing reminded members.
noticias.entradilla: Syncing folders is not the same as backing up, a thread about Syncthing reminded members. INCIBE recommends the 3-2-1 rule: three copies, on two different media, with one of them off-site.

noticias.titular: The group distinguished vibe coding, creating digital resources with AI and natural language, from agentic…
noticias.entradilla: The group distinguished vibe coding, creating digital resources with AI and natural language, from agentic AI, which pursues goals autonomously. It is an everyday explanation, not an official definition.

noticias.titular: On 27 October the AEPD (Spain’s data protection authority) published a ten-point guide for people who use…
noticias.entradilla: On 27 October the AEPD (Spain’s data protection authority) published a ten-point guide for people who use AI assistants and agents. It recommends that the agent prepares and the person approves, with minimal permissions and confirmation before sending, sharing or paying.

noticias.titular: GitHub’s documentation states that teachers verified on GitHub Education can access Copilot Pro for free,…
noticias.entradilla: GitHub’s documentation states that teachers verified on GitHub Education can access Copilot Pro for free, and that eligibility is reassessed every month.
